This looks like an arugula salad with a light dressing and a few small pale pieces, possibly shaved parmesan or nuts. I estimated about 60 g of arugula, which is roughly 15 kcal. Dressing adds about 1 tbsp of oil, around 60-80 kcal, and the cheese or nuts add about 20 kcal. That gives roughly 100 kcal over about 80 g of food.
